crossRefs.note: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
“Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
“Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge…
For who has stood in the council of Yahweh, that he should perceive and hear his word? Who has listened to my word, and…
“For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for…
However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself…
I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to…
The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after…
how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,
by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
translations.bsb: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to instruct Him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
translations.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.
translations.asv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.
